newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: EU crude and oil product stocks all fall in June.
newsitem.headline: EU crude and oil product stocks all fall in June.

text.p: Crude and oil product stocks in the 15 countries of the European Union plus Norway all fell in June, Stitching Euroilstock said in its latest monthly report.
Crude and oil product stocks combined fell by 18.62 million barrels, or 1.7 percent, to 1,059.89 million barrels at the end of June.
Crude stocks fell the most, dropping 11.61 million barrels, or 2.7 percent, in June to 416.90 million barrels, leaving them 8.91 million barrels, or 2.1 percent, lower than year-ago levels.
Gasoline inventories dropped by 2.89 million barrels, or 1.8 percent, in June to 158.10 million barrels and were 11.05 million barrels, or 6.5 percent, lower than a year ago.
Middle distillate stocks fell by 1.65 million barrels, or 0.5 percent, to 314.40 million barrels. This left them 15.15 million barrels, or 5.1 percent, higher than a year ago.
Fuel oil stocks were 2.47 million barrels, or 1.7 percent, lower in June at 145.41 million barrels. This left a year-on-year surplus of 1.29 million barrels, or 0.9 percent.
Naphtha stocks were unchanged at 25.08 million barrels.
Crude intake was 280,000 barrels per day (bpd), or 2.4 percent, higher than in May at 11.955 million bpd, leading to a utilisation rate of 90.57 percent in May.
A full inventory list, including country-by-country data, in barrels and tonnes, is on Reuters pages EUROILA to EUROILJ.
